en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a countryside inn named "Gasthof zum Erbgericht" in a rural, hilly landscape with orchards, a path in the foreground, and additional farm buildings in the background. Two men in early‑20th‑century attire stand on the grassy slope. Printed German text identifies the place as Hartmannsbach near Bad Gottleuba, and the card credits a Meissen-based printer/publisher.
